assessment: All eleven retained pages were text-read and visually inspected, including graphical abstract, seven numbered figures, all panels/captions/legends and nineteen printed equations. No main-PDF table is present: Tables A 1/A 2 and additional maps are in an explicit external supplement, unlocated locally. Thirty-four limited checks and disclosed graph/tree/weight/horizon examples do not reproduce the native Kazakhstan MILP, hydraulic design or Monte Carlo study. Two exact original-passage checks support scoped temporal-planning/financial-risk context; all other source chains and native assets remain open. No accepted operating/GHG input changed.

sections.assessment: Amina Togay, Gaini Serik and Woojin Lee; JCP 525(2025)146563, DOI10.1016/j.jclepro.2025.146563. Received 10 March/revised 23 June/accepted 5 September/online 11 September 2025. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; this does not establish the advertised code licence.

Read input/tool/map workflow, partial/full sketches and cost/environment outcomes. First-optimized/open-source/dynamic claims are not independent novelty or implementation verification. Abstract emissions 140.55/142.73 Mt, residual/abatement naming and case coverage require reconciliation.

Read global/Kazakh emissions, hubs, early optimization, dynamic planning, risk, SimCCS/InfraCCS and multi-objective literature. Exact editions and claims remain qualified; no reproducible exhaustive search protocol identified.

Scenario flexibility, weighted objectives and accessible code are claimed. Equations show no explicit time index/horizon or stochastic storage-capacity constraint; native implementation may differ but is unverified. Transport-only MC does not demonstrate calibrated geological uncertainty.

Read nearest versus least-cost sink language, full cluster redirection and partial source/subcluster assignment. min_samples 2 and eps neighbor distance do not impose cluster diameter or centroid-radius limits. Native geodetic metric, noise handling and routing/cost coupling unknown.

Read data, scenario, clustering, optimization and visualization stages. Seven radii 100/180/200/240/300/360/400 and two logics are case sweeps. Native repository URI is CCS-Net Optmizer, while prose calls CCS-Net Optimizer; do not repair the URL.

Literal EI+TC is unnormalized with unlike units. Dominant environmental weight and strict priority are asserted without weights/bounds. Technical proxies US/EU and Kazakhstan cost adjustments are disclosed, but factors and money-time bases are not fully available.

Eq 2 uses capture fraction, unit cost and annual flow; dimensional annual cost versus USD label needs clarification. MEA regeneration heat is discussed but not inventoried in environmental Eq 11. TableA 1 is external SI.

Read four-term pipeline cost, Darcy-Weisbach/Haaland references, booster costs/compression and reuse. Original coefficient units/vintage, molar basis, MW/W/k Wh conventions and operating hours unresolved. Unrestricted tie-in is an explicit idealization, not a permission or integrity assessment.

Read DC/IE exponential depth cost, 21-well scaling claim, compressor cost and positive-head injection expression. Native coefficients, well-count formula, backpressure/datum/phase and pressure safety not supplied. No correction to gravity sign or currency scale is assumed.

Read Eq 9–15. Residual uncaptured mass is called capture emissions; it omits a complete capture-utility footprint. Burden versus abatement, m/km, kg/t and power/energy bases need native reconciliation. No generic leakage or full LCA factor accepted.

Six sector groups total 88 sources and 148.53 Mt/y. National energy shares differ from selected-source denominators. Source IDs, coordinates, capture fractions and radius-specific included baselines require data/SI.

Read static volumetric method, national 583 Gt/four-basin 539 Gt and selected 17 sites 5784 Mt. These are different resource levels, not pressure-limited annual service. Essential properties/efficiencies are in external TableA 2.

Read every index/quantifier in Eq 17–19. Eq 17 printed i-summation differs from stated one-sink-per-source meaning. Capacity-rate horizon and route/source linking are incomplete in the displayed formulation. No native solver/certificate reproduced.

Read five uniform marginals, 5000 trials, Python 3.12/Num Py and rerouting. CRF now means capital recovery, not capture fraction. Joint dependence, seed, inputs and trials unavailable; empirical P 5–P 95 is not a confidence interval for a median or model truth.

Read 100 km cost minimum, 360 km environmental map, unit costs and comparisons with other regions/prior work. Chart costs are nonmonotonic; denominator, scope and cost-vintage differences prevent universal comparisons or exact native-case reproduction.

Read percentages, MC bands, existing-network savings and length/parallel-pipe claims. MUSD prose/component legend conflicts with BUSD axes/uncertainty prose.200 km pragmatic limit, 240–300 tradeoff and 360 environment priority are different conditional recommendations.

Read 99.95%capture, <0.06%transport, <0.0003%injection, leakage<0.01%/y and site/thickness arguments. Captured mass is separate from residual in Figure 6. No process heat inventory, field leakage calibration or formation-pressure model validates these claims.

Read subsidies, credits, EOR, legislative changes, ISO, international learning, pilots and public trust. Recommendations are not adopted current law, verified implementation readiness or measured climate effects.
Read 100/360/240–300 radius recommendations and explicit future dynamic/GIS/real-time work. Planning utility and comparison are not pressure qualification or proven full-model reproducibility.

equations.check: Unlike units and undisclosed weights/normalization; finite weighted sums do not automatically implement strict lexicographic priority.
Capture-rate fraction times USD/t times t/y gives USD/y; printed USD label and horizon unresolved. This CRF differs from MC capital recovery.
All four exponents/coefficient terms transcribed. Coefficient units, diameter/length basis, currency/vintage and cost annualization require exact original/native code.
Printed USD/MW scaling is not established as millionUSD; no arbitrary factor inserted.
Universal molar R with kg/s requires a molar-mass/specific-gas reinterpretation; W/MW conversion and phase validity unresolved. Analyst illustration is not native repair.
Exponential depth relation despite power-law prose; a 2 must match inverse depth units. a 1/a 2 and 21-well scaling inputs absent.
Same scale/power basis ambiguity as Eq 4; Eq 8 power and Eq 15 energy are not interchangeable.

equations.printed: P_inj = Q(Delta P_s + Delta P_f)/e = Q[rho g D + f D rho nu^2/(2 d_w)]/e
equations.check: With consistent g units the expression yields W. Native g unit m/s is preserved; gravity/backpressure/datum, flow/density/phase and annual-energy conversion need native verification.
Sum represents residual/burden components, while prose calls net abatement. Do not minimize useful abatement by copying a mislabeled objective.
At fixed source baseline maximizing this quantity corresponds to minimizing Eq 9. Varying plotted source coverage prevents an assumed common baseline.
Uncaptured residual, not a capture heat/electricity inventory or complete upstream footprint.
Factor t/km/y versus Lm conflicts; prose also mentions per-ton dependence absent from equation. No field-calibrated leakage factor accepted.
Weighted-average interpretation needs indexed factors/shares and source mix; individual inputs absent.0.882 remains quoted, not independently verified.
Intensity kg/k Wh times annual k Wh gives kg/y; conversion to declared total t/y needed. Earlier P denotes power, not annual energy.
Same kg/t and power/energy distinction as Eq 14; no native hours or injection-duty balance supplied.

equations.check: Route selection/linkage, free j and RHSminimum scope need specification; great-circle approximations exclude terrain/protected land/least-cost routing. No full solver proof.

claims.claim: The framework claims first optimized Central Asian hubs and accessible open-source planning.
claims.assessment: Novelty, repository licence and full implementation are unverified. Broad comparisons do not close source/model checks.

claims.claim: 100 km is cheapest, with 240–300 km tradeoffs and 360 km environmental priority.
claims.assessment: Discussion also proposes a roughly 200 km pragmatic limit. These are conditional recommendations rather than one universally validated design.

claims.claim: Global CCS deployment and Kazakhstan energy context motivate planning.
claims.assessment: Dated 45 Mt/7.6 Gt scenario, coal share and industry claims are not current measured Paper 1 inputs.

claims.claim: Shared hubs may save up to 40% and support phased deployment.
claims.assessment: Exact benchmark scope and counterfactual need originals; no guaranteed savings elsewhere.

claims.claim: Early optimization and retrofit work underpins CCS planning.
claims.assessment: Lee 2014 pp 1–3 supports multi-period retrofit, finite rate/capacity and compensatory power. Existing temporal/energy prior art is verified within this scope.

claims.claim: Zhang2019 addresses uncertain prices and geological storage failures.
claims.assessment: Inspected pp 1, 2, 4 establish carbon-tax financial risk and geological literature context. They do not establish an author-calibrated physical failure model.

claims.claim: Storage uncertainty and open multi-objective tools motivate the new framework.
claims.assessment: Garnett/Olson/Fan originals and their integration remain unverified. Transport MC/static volume do not prove stochastic dynamic storage implementation.

claims.claim: SimCCS, InfraCCS and regional tools have limitations.
claims.assessment: Knoope 2013 is a pipeline-model review. Middleton 2020 and Energy Procedia 2009 differ from retained B 3-44 IJGGC 2009; no edition substitution.

claims.claim: Zhang2023 provides Northeast China multi-objective MILP.
claims.assessment: Printed Zhang/Hou/Zhu 2023 title concerns DBSCAN pipeline data generation/verification. Exact identity and claimed support remain unresolved.

claims.claim: Pricing, network and LCA studies demonstrate multi-objective planning.
claims.assessment: Original cases/contributions unverified, including DBSCAN attribution and source-specific modelling claims.

claims.claim: Full and partial redirection handle capacity mismatches differently.
claims.assessment: Nearest versus least-cost rules need code verification. Hub splitting differs from fractional splitting of a source under the printed assignment condition.

claims.claim: DBSCAN with min_samples2 and MST organizes hubs.
claims.assessment: Epsilon bounds neighbors rather than cluster diameter/centroid distance. Minimum length does not automatically minimize flow-weighted cost.

claims.claim: Regional examples motivate different clustering and redirection choices.
claims.assessment: Unverified Northern Lights, Australia and Decatur cases do not establish universal radius rules.

claims.claim: Existing pipelines may accelerate deployment and reduce costs.
claims.assessment: Material, pressure, tie-in, ownership and permission remain unverified. Unrestricted entry/exit is a modelling idealization.

claims.claim: CCS-NetOptimizer code, dependencies and sample data are advertised.
claims.assessment: Exact URI is https://github.com/aminatgy/CCS-NetOptmizer. Commit, licence, solver and full-case correspondence unverified; retrieval paused.

claims.claim: A weighted goal first eliminates unstored emissions, then minimizes cost.
claims.assessment: Undisclosed finite weights and normalization do not prove strict priority. No native solver certificate or full MILP reproduced.

claims.claim: US/EU technical proxies and Kazakhstan cost adjustments support estimates.
claims.assessment: Disclosed geographic proxies remain context until exact factors, boundaries and external Table A 1 are checked.

claims.claim: Post-combustion MEA offers retrofit adaptability with a heat penalty.
claims.assessment: No complete heat, power, cooling, compression or utility-supplier inventory supplied. Original cost studies unverified.

claims.claim: Capture cost uses a rate factor, unit cost and annual emissions.
claims.assessment: Result is dimensionally USD/y unless another input basis is used. Money horizon and CRF acronym reuse need clarification.

claims.claim: Pipeline and booster formulas represent geometry, power and lifespan.
claims.assessment: Original units, coefficients, time basis and hydraulics unverified. Precomputed nonlinear engineering costs can be used in MILP; no automatic native formulation error claimed.

claims.claim: Pipeline reuse may reduce unit transport cost by up to 44%.
claims.assessment: Cited potential and unrestricted tie-in do not verify actual savings or usable capacity.

claims.claim: Storage costs use regional well/equipment/compressor scaling.
claims.assessment: a 1/a 2, EIA factors, well-count treatment and currency/power scales unavailable. No guessed values supplied.

claims.claim: Injection power includes static/friction terms at 85% efficiency.
claims.assessment: No demonstrated reservoir backpressure, injectivity, fracture/fault limit or dynamic pressure control. Datum, gravity convention and annual energy remain open.

claims.claim: Environmental objectives sum capture, transport and storage emissions.
claims.assessment: Capture term is uncaptured source CO2, not a complete utility footprint. Burden/abatement labels and units require consistent accounting.

claims.claim: Grid and fugitive factors are 0.882 kgCO2e/kWh and 1.4 tCO2/km/y.
claims.assessment: Primary mix and leak calibration unverified. Printed m/km and kg/t conflicts remain; no factor accepted.

claims.claim: Six source groups emit 148.53 Mt/y.
claims.assessment: Counts sum to 88. National and selected-source power shares differ in basis; per-radius included IDs and coverage remain unknown.

claims.claim: National resources are 583 Gt; seventeen selected sites total 5784 Mt.
claims.assessment: Different aggregation levels. Table A 2 properties/efficiencies unavailable; no safe annual service or empirical leak bound established.

claims.claim: Equations17–19 enforce allocation, capacity and optimal routing.
claims.assessment: Printed index, stock/rate horizon and route/source coupling need verification. Great-circle distances omit terrain and land constraints.

claims.claim: Five thousand uniform trials quantify transportation uncertainty.
claims.assessment: Marginals and percentiles do not supply the seed, dependence, full data or full-system uncertainty. No native MC replay.

claims.claim: 100 km clustering saves up to 25% versus dispersed strategies.
claims.assessment: Baseline, coverage and exact network unavailable; no universal transferable percentage accepted.

claims.claim: 100 km costs are 201.38/207.61 USD/t, with 91.85/96.48 transport.
claims.assessment: Arithmetic checked. Implied approximately 115.7 Mt denominators do not resolve stored/abated and money-time accounting.

claims.claim: Transport costs rise toward 197.23 USD/t at 400 km.
claims.assessment: Total-cost chart is nonmonotonic. Long-distance burden does not verify a monotonic total or complete hydraulic design.

claims.claim: Capture/transport shares are 50.47/45.61% at100 and36.17/61.01% at180 km.
claims.assessment: Residual shares 3.92/2.82% are arithmetic only. Full decomposition and common source coverage unverified.

claims.claim: Existing network reduces cost amounts11to10 and24to23.
claims.assessment: MUSD prose conflicts with BUSD axes/later prose by 1000. Savings 9.09%/4.17% are scale-free; absolute native amounts unresolved.

claims.claim: Abatement plateaus around123 Mt and MC intervals widen.
claims.assessment: Source coverage and naming need exact cases. P 5–P 95 quantiles are not confidence in median, model truth or native equivalence.

claims.claim: Full/partial medians differ less than6%, with overlapping intervals.
claims.assessment: Overlap does not prove equal expectation, equivalence or paired rank probability. Native joint trials unavailable.

claims.claim: Intersections span285–2800 km and five parallel northern pipes begin near270 km radius.
claims.assessment: Physical versus unique-corridor lengths and sizing unverified.270 is not one of seven plotted radii; earlier four-pipe case has different coverage.

claims.claim: Capture accounts for99.95%, transport<0.06%, injection<0.0003% of emissions.
claims.assessment: Residual accounting/unit/case limits do not establish a complete capture-energy footprint or negligible physical transport burden.

claims.claim: Managed storage leaks below0.01% per year.
claims.assessment: No site-calibrated original support identified here. Not an accepted retention factor or verified safety guarantee.

claims.claim: Thick T16 and selected formations may lower injection footprint.
claims.assessment: Eq 8 lacks an explicit permeability/thickness reservoir-pressure model. Native controls and geomechanics are needed.

claims.claim: Policy, credits, EOR, pilots and international standards could enable deployment.
claims.assessment: Recommendations are not current adopted rules or causal outcomes. Economic EOR value is not a whole-chain climate credit.

claims.claim: Future GIS, real-time clustering and dynamic storage would improve planning.
claims.assessment: Explicit future work is not verified present capability or field pressure control.

claims.claim: SI, requested data, AI use, funding and contributions are disclosed.
claims.assessment: No SI/code inspection or independent correctness/conflict assessment. Paper licence does not establish repository rights.

claims.claim: All48 bibliography entries have source-status records.
claims.assessment: Only selected Lee 2014/Zhang 2019 passages checked.46 other direct sources, 3 named authorities and 14 dependencies remain open; neither cited paper completed.

claims.claim: Paper1 should acknowledge clustering/redirection prior work while holding unresolved quantities.
claims.assessment: No accepted cost, heat/power, emission, leakage, retention or annual service input added. Full native models/assets remain unreproduced.
